items.raw_excerpt: Vienna tenants can get their rent checked for free this week, while Austria has officially recorded its hottest summer in 260 years, plus more stories from Austria on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Tenants in Vienna can get their rent amounts checked for free this week. The service helps people find out if they are paying too much rent. It is part of ongoing efforts to protect tenants in the Austrian capital.
items.summary_ko: 빈에 사는 세입자들은 이번 주 무료로 임대료 검증 서비스를 이용할 있습니다. 이 서비스를 통해 자신이 과도한 임대료를 내고 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다. 이는 오스트리아 수도의 세입자 보호를 위한 활동 중 하나입니다.
items.title_en: Vienna Tenants Can Get Rent Checked For Free This Week

items.raw_excerpt: Discover why a Bengaluru 'peptide party' was banned and learn about peptides' role in biohacking and health risks.
items.summary_en: Bengaluru authorities banned a 'peptide party' that promoted peptides for biohacking and health. Peptides are small proteins some people use to try to improve performance and wellness. The event was stopped because peptide use without medical supervision can be dangerous.
items.summary_ko: 벵갈루루 당국은 바이오해킹과 건강을 위해 펩타이드를 홍보하는 '펩타이드 파티'를 금지했습니다. 펩타이드는 일부 사람들이 체능 향상과 건강을 위해 사용하는 소단백질입니다. 의료 감독 없이 펩타이드를 사용하면 위험할 수 있어 해당 행사가 중단되었습니다.
items.title_en: Why was a 'peptide party' banned in Bengaluru?
items.title_original: Why was a ‘peptide party’ banned in Bengaluru? | Explained

items.raw_excerpt: Called Drive to Malaysia, the service allows users to book a GetGo vehicle through its app and drive anywhere in West Malaysia.
items.summary_en: Called Drive to Malaysia, the service lets users book a GetGo car through its app. They can then drive anywhere in West Malaysia.
items.summary_ko: Drive to Malaysia라는 이름의 이 서비스는 GetGo 앱을 통해 차량을 예약할 수 있게 해줍니다. 사용자는 서말레이시아 전역을 자유롭게 운전할 수 있습니다.

items.summary_en: The weather will be mostly clear across Greece. Some temporary clouds will appear during the midday and afternoon hours. Temperatures will stay about the same.

items.raw_excerpt: The Central Weather Administration (CWA) on Tuesday issued heavy or extremely heavy rain advisories for seven cities and counties in southern Taiwan, warning that a low-pressure system could bring localized heavy rain and sudden downpours.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Central Weather Administration issued heavy or extremely heavy rain advisories for seven cities and counties in southern Taiwan. A low-pressure system is expected to bring localized heavy rain and sudden downpours to the area.
items.summary_ko: 대만 중앙기상청은 남부 7개 시·현에 폭우 또는 극한 폭우 주의보를 발표했다. 저기압 영향으로 지역에 강한 비와 갑작스러운 소나기가 예상된다.
items.title_en: Heavy rain advisory issued for southern Taiwan
items.title_original: CWA issues heavy rain advisories for southern Taiwan

items.raw_excerpt: This comes after South Korea similarly stepped up inspections of Chinese cabbage imports as the food safety scandal in China, involving the vegetables being dipped in formaldehyde, stirs regional concern.
items.summary_en: Singapore has increased testing of Chinese cabbage after reports that vegetables in China were treated with formaldehyde. The food safety authority is checking imports to make sure they are safe. South Korea has also started similar inspections.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르가 중국에서 채소에 포르말데히데를 사용했다는 보도 이후 중국산 양배추 검사를 강화했다. 식품안전청은 수입품이 안전한지 확인하고 있다. 한국도 비슷한 검사를 시작했다.
items.title_en: Singapore steps up cabbage testing following reports of formaldehyde use in China

items.title_original: Singapore steps up cabbage testing following reports of formaldehyde use in China

items.raw_excerpt: In Edamalakkudy, patients are repeatedly carried on bamboo stretchers due to lack of road access, highlighting urgent healthcare needs.
items.summary_en: In Edamalakkudy, patients are repeatedly carried on bamboo stretchers due to lack of road access. This highlights urgent healthcare needs in the remote area. It is the fourth such incident in a month.
items.summary_ko: 에다말라쿠디에서는 도로 접근이 없어 환자들이 반복적으로 대나무 들것에 실려 병원으로 이송되고 있습니다. 이는 해당 지역의 시급한 의료 서비스 필요성을 보여줍니다. 한 달 내 네 번째 발생한 사건입니다.

items.title_original: Patient carried on makeshift bamboo stretcher to hospital in Keralam’s Edamalakkudy; fourth incident in a month

items.raw_excerpt: "Este es un juego que pierdes dos partidos y a mí me echan a la mierda", dijo tras vencer a O’Higgins.
items.summary_en: Football coach Garnero spoke after his team's victory over O'Higgins. He criticized the double standard in how their performance is analyzed. The match was part of Chile's first division league.
items.summary_ko: 가르네로 감독이 오히긴스전 승리 후 인터뷰에서 팀 성적에 대한 이중잣대를 비판했습니다. 칠레 1부 리그 경기에서 나온 발언입니다.
items.title_en: Garnero said: When we don't play well there's deep analysis, others get results and everything is great

items.raw_excerpt: Tasmania's cultural institutions are set to face another blow as the Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery looks to reduce its workforce by 30 per cent, figures refuted by the state government.
items.summary_en: The Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery plans to cut 30 percent of its workers. The state government disputes the exact number of job losses. Arts funding cuts are hitting cultural institutions in Tasmania.
items.summary_ko: 타즈메이니아 박물관 미술관이 전체 직원의 30%를 줄일 계획입니다. 주정부는 감원 규모 수치를 다투고 있습니다. 호주 예술 지원금 삭감이 타즈메이니아 지역 문화 기관에 타격을 주고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Tasmanian museum plans to cut 30 percent of its staff

items.raw_excerpt: Da Redação – Os candidatos ao Governo de Pernambuco cumprem agendas no Recife e na Região Metropolitana nesta terça-feira (1º). Raquel Lyra (PSD) participa de caminhadas em Jaboatão dos Guararapes e Moreno; João Campos (PSB) concede entrevista, participa de um diálogo na UPE e encerra o dia em Goiana; e Ivan Moraes (PSOL) tem compromissos […]
items.summary_en: Three candidates for governor of Pernambuco held campaign events around Recife. Raquel Lyra walked in Jaboatão dos Guararapes and Moreno. João Campos gave an interview and spoke at UPE, then visited Goiana, while Ivan Moraes discussed mental health.
items.summary_ko: 페르남부코 주지사 선거 후보 3명이 레시페와 주변 도시에서 선거 일정을 소화했다. 라울 리라는 자바탕 두스 과라라피스와 모레노에서 거리행진에 참여했고, 지앙 카무스는 인터뷰와 토론회 후 고이아나를 방문했으며, 이반 모라에스는 정신건강 의제를 논의했다.
items.title_ko: 페르남부코 주지사 후보자들이 레시페 일대에서 선거 운동

items.raw_excerpt: Denmark sets age limit for men in fertility treatments, tractor protest expected to cause disruption on the roads and more news from Denmark on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Farmers in Denmark plan a tractor protest that will likely cause traffic disruptions on roads. The demonstration reflects ongoing agricultural concerns in the country. Commuters in affected areas should expect delays.

items.raw_excerpt: Adelaide's new $96 million MotoGP track has received mixed reviews from motorsport fans and riders, with some excited by the return of heritage elements but worried it is "not going to make for very interesting racing".
items.summary_en: Adelaide's new 96 million dollar MotoGP track has divided motorsport fans. Some love the return of classic track features, but others fear the design will produce dull racing.
